Email Marketing
Email Marketing refers to the process of promoting a business through email communications.

Email Marketing Plan
An Email Marketing Plan is a strategy for using email to achieve business goals.

Dashboard
The Dashboard is a control panel or interface where users can manage their email marketing activities.<SEP>The dashboard is a central hub for managing and accessing various tools and features within a platform or system.<SEP>The dashboard is a user interface or control panel that provides access to various tools and features, including the Hotels tab.<SEP>The Dashboard is a tool where users can manage their site's settings, including pricing plans and coupons.<SEP>The dashboard is where users can access and manage their collection content.

Monthly Balance refers to the amount of email sending capacity available to a user each month.

Upgrade
Upgrade is the process of improving or enhancing an email marketing plan to access more features.

Business
A Business is an entity that operates to provide goods or services, potentially using email marketing.

Package
A Package refers to a set of features or services offered in an email marketing plan.

Checkout

Site
The Site is the online platform where the email marketing dashboard is accessed.<SEP>The site refers to the platform or system where the site dashboard and client data are managed.<SEP>The site refers to the online platform where the collections and datasets are displayed.

Wix Stores
Wix Stores is an eCommerce platform that provides tools for creating online stores and selling products.

Wix
Wix is a company that provides a comprehensive platform for creating and managing websites, offering a wide range of services and features to its users. The company's platform includes tools for building and managing websites, content management systems, and website hosting services, as well as domain registration. Wix enables users to create dynamic pages and manage collections, making it a versatile platform for various online needs.

In addition to website creation and hosting, Wix offers specialized services such as Wix Stores, a platform for creating and managing online stores, and Wix Bookings, a feature that enables users to manage bookings and appointments. The company also provides payment services, including Wix Payments, which allows for direct payment acceptance. Furthermore, Wix supports various alternative payment providers, including PayPal, giving users flexibility and convenience in managing their online transactions.

Wix prioritizes user experience, offering a customer care team for support and requiring account verification to ensure secure payment services. The platform also allows for domain connection via pointing, making it easy for users to establish an online presence. Overall, Wix is a one-stop solution for individuals and businesses looking to create, manage, and grow their online presence, providing a seamless and user-friendly experience for its customers. With its broad range of services and features, Wix caters to the diverse needs of its users, from website creation and hosting to online store management and payment processing.<SEP>Wix is a website creation platform that can be connected to Google Workspace.

eCommerce
eCommerce refers to the buying and selling of products or services online.

Dropshipping
Dropshipping is a retail fulfillment method where a store does not keep the products it sells in stock.

Modalyst

Spocket
Spocket is a dropshipping service that can be connected to Wix Stores.

Printful

Printify

Avalara

Google

eBay

Facebook

Amazon

Wix Payments
Wix Payments is a payment service offered by Wix for secure online transactions.<SEP>Wix Payments is a payment provider that allows for direct payment acceptance and has its own payout management.<SEP>Wix Payments is a payment provider available on the Wix platform.<SEP>Wix Payments is a payment processing service that requires identity verification for account activation.<SEP>Wix Payments is a payment service provided by Wix, requiring account verification for its users.

PayPal
PayPal is a payment service that can be used with Wix Stores for online transactions.<SEP>PayPal is a payment provider that allows businesses to accept payments online.<SEP>PayPal is a payment method available in Wix Bookings.

CMS
CMS stands for Content Management System, a platform for managing and organizing content.<SEP>CMS refers to a content management system that allows users to control and manage their site's content.<SEP>CMS stands for Content Management System, which is used to manage collection content.<SEP>CMS stands for Content Management System, which is a platform for managing and publishing digital content.

Collection View
The collection view is where items are displayed and can be reordered or hidden.<SEP>A collection view is a way to organize and display items in a collection, allowing for customization and filtering.<SEP>A collection view is a way to organize and display items in a collection within the CMS.<SEP>The collection view is a feature in Wix's CMS that allows users to manage and organize their collections.

Fields
Fields refer to the individual elements or columns within a collection view, which can be hidden, shown, or reordered.

Editor
The editor is a tool or interface used for creating, modifying, and managing content within a platform or system.<SEP>The editor is another location where users can access and manage their collection content.

Datasets
Datasets refer to collections of data that can be used to populate and update content on a website or other platform.

Mirror On Site
Mirror on Site is a feature that allows the order of items in a collection view to be mirrored on a live website.<SEP>Mirror On Site is a feature that allows users to mirror the order of items in their collection view to their live site.<SEP>Mirror on site is a feature that allows users to mirror their collection's item order on their website.<SEP>Mirror On Site is a feature that allows users to mirror the item order of a collection on their live site.

FAQs
FAQs, or Frequently Asked Questions, are a type of content that provides answers to common questions about a topic or system.<SEP>FAQs refer to a section of frequently asked questions that provide answers to common queries about sorting, filtering, and mirroring live site content.<SEP>Frequently Asked Questions provide answers to common questions about managing CMS collection content.

Collection
A collection is a grouping of items that can be controlled and managed.<SEP>A collection refers to a group of items or data that can be managed and organized within a CMS.<SEP>A collection is a group of items that can be managed and displayed on a site.<SEP>A collection consists of distinct fields and items, with each item's content stored in its fields.<SEP>A collection in the context of Wix's CMS refers to a group of related content items.

Item
An item is an individual element or entry within a collection, which can have various fields and properties associated with it.<SEP>An item is a component of a collection, consisting of multiple fields and their values.

Field Values
Field values refer to the specific data or content entered into a field within a collection or item.

Sort
Sort is a method or feature used to arrange items in a collection in a specific order based on certain criteria or conditions.

Filter
Filter is a method or feature used to selectively display or hide items in a collection based on specific conditions or criteria.

Mirror On Site Feature
The Mirror on Site feature applies the order of the collection view to connected site elements.

A Text field type is used for sorting items in an alphabetic sequence.

A dataset is a collection of items that can be sorted and controlled.<SEP>A dataset is a collection of data that can be used to sort and filter items on a site.<SEP>A dataset is a connection between page elements and CMS collection content.<SEP>A dataset is a collection of data that can be used to filter and sort collection items.

Numerical Sorting

Item Visibility
Item visibility refers to the ability to control whether items are shown or hidden on a live site.

Field Type
Field type refers to the classification of a field, such as Text or Number, which determines its sorting behavior.<SEP>Field types in Wix's CMS determine the type of content that can be stored in a field, such as text, image, or date.

Gallery Layout
